## 🔗 Related Issue
Closes # https://github.com/IBM/mcp-context-forge/issues/4570

---

## 📝 Summary
The session_affinity.py created closable pubsub entity without close. 
Fix: 
```
    pubsub = redis.pubsub()
```
replaced with 
```
   async with redis.pubsub() as pubsub: 
```
The other changes in this file were introduced by pre-commit.
